na95d5c448b.headline: Zambia : We Need To Tranform The Civil Service From A Consumption Entity To Production One-Felix Mutati
na95d5c448b.summary: Zambian Finance Minister Felix Mutati emphasized the need to reform the civil service to become more productive rather than consumption-oriented.
na95d5c448b.why: Civil service efficiency affects government spending and economic growth prospects in Zambia, influencing fiscal policy and investor sentiment.

nbcd3b17de4.headline: TSX dips as banks, energy and Fed uncertainty weigh
nbcd3b17de4.summary: The Toronto Stock Exchange declined due to pressure on banks and energy sectors amid uncertainty over U.S. Federal Reserve policy.
nbcd3b17de4.why: The TSX is Canada's main equity index, sensitive to financial and energy sector performance and U.S. monetary policy, which influences investor sentiment and capital flows.

impacts.name: TSX
impacts.why: Fed uncertainty affects investor risk appetite, impacting Canadian equities, especially banks and energy sectors.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nbcd3b17de4.why_moved: Investor caution ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve policy decision led to selling pressure on Canadian banks and energy stocks, dragging the TSX lower.
